title: DeDi File
description: A self-contained, signed JSON document holding one registry (directory) and its records. Served as application/json; the dedi.<registry-name>.json filename and /dedi/ directory are RECOMMENDED conventions, not conformance requirements. Hosted by the publisher at any URL it controls, or embedded verbatim as an inline entry in the manifest's files[] (shape and verification unchanged; source_url is then the manifest's well-known URL); discovered, verified and served by DeDi servers. Authenticity is established by confirming publisher.key appears in the keys of the publisher's signed /.well-known/dedi.index.json. See docs/publishing-dedi-files.md. NOTE: the schema $id points at the mutable main branch and must be pinned to a release tag before release.

dedi_version.description: Version of the DeDi file format, e.g. '0.1'.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this document as a DeDi file. Required: the dedi.*.json filename and /dedi/ path are conventions only, so a conformant file may arrive with neither. This is the one self-identification that always travels with the content.

source_url.description: Canonical location; used to re-fetch a fresher copy after the file has been relocated to a mirror.

next_update.description: After this time the file MUST be treated as stale and re-fetched from source_url before being relied upon.

domain.description: Publisher identity — a domain it controls. Its /.well-known/dedi.index.json MUST list the key below.

key.description: PUBLIC signing key as an RFC 7517 JWK. Embedded so the file is integrity-verifiable offline. Private key material MUST NOT appear.

kid.description: Key id; MUST equal proof.verification_method and match a key in the publisher's manifest.

namespace.description: The DeDi namespace name (usually the domain); maps to {namespace} in /dedi/lookup.

schema.description: The schema the records' `details` conform to: a URL to a JSON Schema, or an inline JSON Schema object. Never anchored to a single central host.

state.description: Whole-registry lifecycle. 'inactive' retires the directory; treat as not authoritative.

updated_at.description: When the registry's content last actually changed (distinct from a re-issue for freshness).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the registry. Mirrors the DeDi API's description field.

meta.description: Optional free-form metadata about the registry. Signed with the rest of the document; carries no verification semantics. Not a place for lifecycle or trust data.

records.description: Pure list entries — each a record name and its schema-conformant data.

record_name.description: Record name; maps to {record_name}. MUST be unique within the registry — duplicates make the file invalid. Case-sensitive; no character-set restriction; percent-encoded when used in a URL path. A record is addressed as {namespace}/{registry_name}/{record_name}.

details.description: The schema-conformant payload; same field as the DeDi API Record.details.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the record. Mirrors the DeDi API's description field.

meta.description: Optional free-form metadata about the record. Signed with the rest of the document; carries no verification semantics. Not a place for lifecycle or trust data — lifecycle stays at the registry level.

proof.description: Detached JWS over the JCS-canonicalized document with this proof block removed, signed by publisher.key.
